```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import polars as pl
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

comparison = pl.read_csv(Path("data") / "unit_dose_comparison.csv")

status_labels = {
    "agree": "Agree",
    "disagree": "values different",
    "vmp_udfs_uom_missing": "UDFS unit missing in OpenPrescribing Hospitals",
    "provisional_udfs_uom_missing": "UDFS unit missing in the provisional extract",
    "missing_from_vmp_data": "VMP not in OpenPrescribing Hospitals",
}
unit_dose_uom_status_labels = {
    "agree": "Agree",
    "disagree": "values different",
    "vmp_unit_dose_uom_missing": (
        "Unit dose unit missing in OpenPrescribing Hospitals"
    ),
    "provisional_unit_dose_uom_missing": (
        "Unit dose unit missing in the provisional extract"
    ),
    "missing_from_vmp_data": "VMP not in OpenPrescribing Hospitals",
}
total_vmps = comparison.height
status_counts = {
    row["status"]: row["VMPs"]
    for row in comparison.group_by("status").len(name="VMPs").iter_rows(named=True)
}


unit_dose_uom_status_counts = {
    row["unit_dose_uom_status"]: row["VMPs"]
    for row in comparison.group_by("unit_dose_uom_status")
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .iter_rows(named=True)
}


def count(status: str) -> int:
    return status_counts.get(status, 0)


def count_unit_dose_uom(status: str) -> int:
    return unit_dose_uom_status_counts.get(status, 0)


def percentage(numerator: int, denominator: int) -> str:
    if denominator == 0:
        return "0.0%"
    return f"{numerator / denominator:.1%}"


def format_udfs(value: float | None) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if abs(value - int(value)) < 1e-6:
        return str(int(value))
    return f"{value:g}"


def show_table(rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> None:
    if not rows:
        display(Markdown("No rows."))
        return

    headers = list(rows[0])
    lines = [
        "| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |",
        "| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in headers) + " |",
    ]
    lines.extend(
        "| " + " | ".join(str(row[header]) for header in headers) + " |"
        for row in rows
    )
    display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))


status_rows = [
    {
        "Status": status_labels[status],
        "VMPs": f"{count(status):,}",
        "Share": percentage(count(status), total_vmps),
    }
    for status in status_labels
]

both_values = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("provisional_udfs_uom_norm").is_not_null()
    & pl.col("vmp_udfs_uom_norm").is_not_null()
)
both_values_total = both_values.height
both_values_agree = both_values.filter(pl.col("status") == "agree").height
both_values_disagree = both_values.filter(pl.col("status") == "disagree").height

disagreements = comparison.filter(pl.col("status") == "disagree")
disagreement_counts = (
    disagreements.group_by(
        "provisional_udfs_uom",
        "udfs_uom",
    )
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .sort("VMPs", descending=True)
)
most_common_disagreement = (
    disagreement_counts.row(0, named=True) if disagreement_counts.height else None
)
disagreement_rows = [
    {
        "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals UDFS unit of measure": row["udfs_uom"],
        "VMPs": f"{row['VMPs']:,}",
    }
    for row in disagreement_counts.iter_rows(named=True)
]
uom_disagree_udfs_agree = disagreements.filter(pl.col("udfs_status") == "agree")
uom_disagree_udfs_disagree = disagreements.filter(
    pl.col("udfs_status") == "disagree"
).sort("vmp_product_name")
uom_disagree_udfs_disagree_rows = [
    {
        "Product": row["vmp_product_name"],
        "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals UDFS unit of measure": row["udfs_uom"],
        "Provisional UDFS": format_udfs(row["provisional_udfs"]),
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals UDFS": format_udfs(row["udfs"]),
    }
    for row in uom_disagree_udfs_disagree.iter_rows(named=True)
]

missing_provisional_udfs_uom = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("status") == "provisional_udfs_uom_missing"
)
missing_provisional_rows = [
    {
        "VMP code": row["vmp_code"],
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals UDFS unit of measure": row["udfs_uom"],
        "`df_ind`": row["df_ind"],
    }
    for row in missing_provisional_udfs_uom.iter_rows(named=True)
]

missing_from_oph = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("status") == "missing_from_vmp_data"
).sort("vmp_product_name")
missing_from_oph_rows = [
    {
        "Product": row["vmp_product_name"],
        "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
    }
    for row in missing_from_oph.iter_rows(named=True)
]

missing_vmp_udfs_uom = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("status") == "vmp_udfs_uom_missing"
)
missing_uom_counts = (
    missing_vmp_udfs_uom.group_by("provisional_udfs_uom")
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .sort("VMPs", descending=True)
)
shown_uom_counts = missing_uom_counts.head(9)
other_uom_counts = missing_uom_counts.slice(9)
missing_uom_rows = [
    {
        "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
        "VMPs": f"{row['VMPs']:,}",
    }
    for row in shown_uom_counts.iter_rows(named=True)
]
if other_uom_counts.height:
    missing_uom_rows.append(
        {
            "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": f"Other ({other_uom_counts.height} values)",
            "VMPs": f"{other_uom_counts.get_column('VMPs').sum():,}",
        }
    )

df_counts = {
    row["df_ind"]: row["VMPs"]
    for row in (
        missing_vmp_udfs_uom.group_by("df_ind")
        .len(name="VMPs")
        .iter_rows(named=True)
    )
}
df_order = ["Continuous", "Not applicable", "Discrete"]
df_rows = [
    {
        "`df_ind`": df_ind,
        "VMPs": f"{df_counts.get(df_ind, 0):,}",
        "Share": percentage(
            df_counts.get(df_ind, 0),
            missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height,
        ),
    }
    for df_ind in df_order
]
missing_df_ind = missing_vmp_udfs_uom.get_column("df_ind").null_count()
discrete_count = df_counts.get("Discrete", 0)
missing_oph_units_match = missing_vmp_udfs_uom.filter(
    pl.col("provisional_units_match")
)
missing_oph_udfs_is_one = missing_vmp_udfs_uom.filter(
    pl.col("provisional_udfs_consistent")
    & pl.col("provisional_udfs").is_not_null()
    & ((pl.col("provisional_udfs") - 1).abs() <= 1e-3)
)

combination_counts = (
    missing_vmp_udfs_uom.group_by(
        "df_ind",
        "provisional_udfs_uom",
    )
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .sort("VMPs", descending=True)
    .head(10)
)
combination_rows = [
    {
        "`df_ind`": row["df_ind"],
        "Provisional UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
        "VMPs": f"{row['VMPs']:,}",
    }
    for row in combination_counts.iter_rows(named=True)
]

uom_agree = comparison.filter(pl.col("status") == "agree")
udfs_agree_when_uom_agrees = uom_agree.filter(pl.col("udfs_status") == "agree")
udfs_disagree_when_uom_agrees = uom_agree.filter(
    pl.col("udfs_status") == "disagree"
).sort("vmp_product_name")
udfs_disagree_when_uom_agrees_rows = [
    {
        "Product": row["vmp_product_name"],
        "UDFS unit of measure": row["provisional_udfs_uom"],
        "Provisional UDFS": format_udfs(row["provisional_udfs"]),
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals UDFS": format_udfs(row["udfs"]),
    }
    for row in udfs_disagree_when_uom_agrees.iter_rows(named=True)
]
udfs_value_disagreement_counts = (
    udfs_disagree_when_uom_agrees.group_by(
        "provisional_udfs",
        "udfs",
        "provisional_udfs_uom",
    )
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .sort("VMPs", descending=True)
)
most_common_udfs_value_disagreement = (
    udfs_value_disagreement_counts.row(0, named=True)
    if udfs_value_disagreement_counts.height
    else None
)

udfs_inconsistent = comparison.filter(
    ~pl.col("provisional_udfs_consistent")
).sort("vmp_product_name")
udfs_inconsistent_rows = [
    {
        "Product": row["vmp_product_name"],
        "Minimum UDFS": format_udfs(row["provisional_udfs_min"]),
        "Maximum UDFS": format_udfs(row["provisional_udfs_max"]),
    }
    for row in udfs_inconsistent.iter_rows(named=True)
]
udfs_consistent_count = total_vmps - udfs_inconsistent.height

unit_dose_uom_status_rows = [
    {
        "Status": unit_dose_uom_status_labels[status],
        "VMPs": f"{count_unit_dose_uom(status):,}",
        "Share": percentage(count_unit_dose_uom(status), total_vmps),
    }
    for status in unit_dose_uom_status_labels
]
both_unit_dose_uom = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("provisional_unit_dose_uom_norm").is_not_null()
    & pl.col("vmp_unit_dose_uom_norm").is_not_null()
)
both_unit_dose_uom_total = both_unit_dose_uom.height
both_unit_dose_uom_agree = both_unit_dose_uom.filter(
    pl.col("unit_dose_uom_status") == "agree"
).height
both_unit_dose_uom_disagree = both_unit_dose_uom.filter(
    pl.col("unit_dose_uom_status") == "disagree"
).height
unit_dose_uom_disagreements = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("unit_dose_uom_status") == "disagree"
)
unit_dose_uom_disagreement_counts = (
    unit_dose_uom_disagreements.group_by(
        "provisional_unit_dose_uom",
        "unit_dose_uom",
    )
    .len(name="VMPs")
    .sort("VMPs", descending=True)
)
most_common_unit_dose_uom_disagreement = (
    unit_dose_uom_disagreement_counts.row(0, named=True)
    if unit_dose_uom_disagreement_counts.height
    else None
)
unit_dose_uom_disagreement_rows = [
    {
        "Provisional unit dose unit of measure": row["provisional_unit_dose_uom"],
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals unit dose unit of measure": row["unit_dose_uom"],
        "VMPs": f"{row['VMPs']:,}",
    }
    for row in unit_dose_uom_disagreement_counts.iter_rows(named=True)
]
missing_vmp_unit_dose_uom = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("unit_dose_uom_status") == "vmp_unit_dose_uom_missing"
)
missing_provisional_unit_dose_uom = comparison.filter(
    pl.col("unit_dose_uom_status") == "provisional_unit_dose_uom_missing"
)
missing_provisional_unit_dose_rows = [
    {
        "VMP code": row["vmp_code"],
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals unit dose unit of measure": row["unit_dose_uom"],
        "`df_ind`": row["df_ind"],
    }
    for row in missing_provisional_unit_dose_uom.iter_rows(named=True)
]
```

## Background

The following notice was added to the [provisional Secondary Care Medicines Data (SCMD)](https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/dataset/secondary-care-medicines-data-indicative-price) on the NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA) Open Data Portal on 25/08/2026:

> Changes have now been introduced to the Secondary Care Medicines Dataset (SCMD) with the\
> June 2026 Provisional data release.
>
> The changes include updates to existing column names and the addition of new columns relating to Virtual Medicinal Product (VMP) unit of measure and quantity.
>
> Column name changes
>
> UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME → VMP_UDFS_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME
>
> UNIT_OF_MEASURE_IDENTIFIER → VMP_UDFS_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_IDENTIFIER
>
> TOTAL_QUANITY_IN_VMP_UNIT → TOTAL_QUANTITY_IN_VMP_UDFS_UNIT_OF_MEASURE New columns
>
> VMP_UNIT_DOSE_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME – Virtual Medicinal Product (VMP) Unit Dose Unit of Measure name
>
> TOTAL_QUANTITY_IN_VMP_UNIT_DOSE_UNIT_OF_MEASURE – Total quantity in Virtual Medicinal \>Product (VMP) Unit Dose Unit of Measure SNOMED code and unit of measure identifier fields are also now provided as string data types.
>
> The Finalised SCMD dataset is published annually and will next be updated in July 2027,\
> covering data for April 2026 to March 2027. The changes introduced to the Provisional dataset will therefore be reflected in the Finalised dataset as part of this annual update.

The unit dose quantity is a quantity that we have previously had to calculate by linking the SCMD to the dm+d, identifying the UDFS value and unit of measure in the dm+d, and converting the quantity reported in the SCMD to the unit dose quantity. We have described how we do this in our blog post, [Calculating unit dose quantity in the Secondary Care Medicines Data](https://www.bennett.ox.ac.uk/blog/2025/06/calculating-unit-dose-quantity-in-the-secondary-care-medicines-data/).

Inclusion of the unit dose quantity in the raw SCMD will allow us to simplify the processing required for use of the data by OpenPrescribing Hospitals. But before we replace the current unit dose quantity calculation, we need to check that the unit doses now reported in the SCMD agrees with the unit doses we have determined using the extra information available through the dm+d.

Below, we describe this comparison.

## Methods

The analysis uses two data sources:

1.  The June 2026 provisional SCMD extract (the only data extract with the additional columns at the time of analysis).
2.  The product information used by OpenPrescribing Hospitals, taken from the dm+d.

To make the comparison, we first identify all of the unique Virtual Medicinal Products (VMPs) that are reported in the June 2026 provisional SCMD extract. For these products, we identify the UDFS unit of measure from the renamed `VMP_UDFS_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME` column and the unit dose unit of measure from the `VMP_UNIT_DOSE_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME` column.

For all of the identified VMPs, we then find the UDFS unit of measure, the UDFS value, and the unit dose unit of measure that are currently used in OpenPrescribing Hospitals.

We compare the UDFS unit of measure and the unit dose unit of measure in the provisional extract with the equivalent fields in the OpenPrescribing Hospitals data.

We count the number of VMPs for which these values agree and for which they do not. Where they do not, we split this count out into:

- **values different** - both sources have a UDFS unit of measure, and the values are different
- **UDFS unit missing in OpenPrescribing Hospitals** - the VMP has a UDFS unit of measure in the provisional extract, but not in OpenPrescribing Hospitals
- **UDFS unit missing in the provisional extract** - the VMP has a UDFS unit of measure in the OpenPrescribing Hospitals data, but not in the provisional extract

Where the UDFS units of measure are different, we also report whether the UDFS values are different.

We also identify any VMPs which are reported in the provisional extract, but not in the OpenPrescribing Hospitals data.

We then compare unit dose form size (UDFS). The provisional extract does not include a UDFS value column, so we have to back-calculate it from the two reported quantity fields. For each organisation row we calculate:

```         
Quantity in the UDFS unit of measure / quantity in the unit dose unit of measure
```

(We've described the differences between unit dose and unit dose form in our blog post, [Getting more from the Secondary Care Medicines Data using the Dictionary of Medicines and Devices](https://www.bennett.ox.ac.uk/blog/2025/03/getting-more-from-the-secondary-care-medicines-data-using-the-dictionary-of-medicines-and-devices/#virtual-medicinal-product-vmp).)

We first check that this value is the same for all organisation rows of a VMP. A relative difference of 0.1% or less between the minimum and maximum counts as the same.

We then compare that UDFS with UDFS in the OpenPrescribing Hospitals data. We restrict this comparison to VMPs where the UDFS unit of measure already agrees.

We also compare the unit dose unit of measure in the new `VMP_UNIT_DOSE_UNIT_OF_MEASURE_NAME` column with `unit_dose_uom` in OpenPrescribing Hospitals. We use the same agreement categories as for the UDFS unit of measure.

## Findings

```{python}
agree_count = count("agree")

        f"Of these, the UDFS units of measure agree for **{agree_count:,} ({percentage(agree_count, total_vmps)})**. "
        f"**{mismatch_count:,} ({percentage(mismatch_count, total_vmps)})** "
        "do not agree. "
        f"**{count('missing_from_vmp_data'):,} "
        f"({percentage(count('missing_from_vmp_data'), total_vmps)})** "
        "are in the provisional extract, but not in the data used by OpenPrescribing Hospitals (there will be newly introduced VMPs only reported in the June 2026 provisional extract)."
    )
)
```

All of the products with a UDFS unit reported in the provisional extract but not in OpenPrescribing Hospitals have a `Continuous` or `Not applicable` dose form indicator. In the processing pipeline for OpenPrescribing Hospitals, these products are excluded from the unit dose quantity calculations as unit doses are not applicable to these products.

```{python}
unit_dose_uom_agree_count = count_unit_dose_uom("agree")
unit_dose_uom_mismatch_count = (
    count_unit_dose_uom("disagree")
    + count_unit_dose_uom("vmp_unit_dose_uom_missing")

)
display(

        f"The unit dose units of measure agree for "
        f"**{unit_dose_uom_agree_count:,} "
        f"({percentage(unit_dose_uom_agree_count, total_vmps)})**. "
        f"**{unit_dose_uom_mismatch_count:,} "

        "do not agree. "
        f"**{count_unit_dose_uom('missing_from_vmp_data'):,} "
        f"({percentage(count_unit_dose_uom('missing_from_vmp_data'), total_vmps)})** "
        "are in the provisional extract, but not in the data used by "
        "OpenPrescribing Hospitals."
    )
)
```

## Conclusions

```{python}
# The conclusion below claims that, for every VMP with a UDFS unit missing in
# OpenPrescribing Hospitals, the provisional UDFS unit equals the provisional
# unit dose unit and the implied UDFS is 1. Stop the render if that is not true.
assert missing_oph_units_match.height == missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height, (
    f"UDFS unit equals unit dose unit for only "
    f"{missing_oph_units_match.height} of {missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height} VMPs"
)
assert missing_oph_udfs_is_one.height == missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height, (
    f"Implied UDFS is 1 for only "
    f"{missing_oph_udfs_is_one.height} of {missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height} VMPs"
)

display(
    Markdown(
        f"For all **{both_values_total:,}** VMPs where both sources have a "
        f"UDFS unit of measure, the units agree for **{both_values_agree:,}**. "
        f"OpenPrescribing Hospitals has no UDFS unit for "
        f"**{missing_vmp_udfs_uom.height:,}** VMPs. All of these products "
        "have a `Continuous` or `Not applicable` dose form indicator, for "
        "which unit doses are not applicable. For all of these products, "
        "the provisional UDFS unit is the same as the provisional unit dose "
        "unit and the implied UDFS is 1 on every organisation row. This is "
        "consistent with treating the UDFS units as unit dose units for "
        "these products."
    )
)
display(
    Markdown(
        f"For the **{uom_agree.height:,}** VMPs with matching UDFS units, "
        f"the implied UDFS value agrees for "
        f"**{udfs_agree_when_uom_agrees.height:,}**. "
        f"**{udfs_disagree_when_uom_agrees.height:,}** have different UDFS "
        "values."
        + (
            " The most common pair is an implied UDFS of "
            f"{format_udfs(most_common_udfs_value_disagreement['provisional_udfs'])} "
            f"{most_common_udfs_value_disagreement['provisional_udfs_uom']} "
            "in the provisional extract and a UDFS of "
            f"{format_udfs(most_common_udfs_value_disagreement['udfs'])} "
            f"{most_common_udfs_value_disagreement['provisional_udfs_uom']} "
            "in OpenPrescribing Hospitals "
            f"({most_common_udfs_value_disagreement['VMPs']:,} VMPs). "
            "These differences need further investigation."
            if most_common_udfs_value_disagreement is not None
            else ""
        )
    )
)
```
